<!-- en -->
v0.1.6 is a feature release: date arguments gain month and year forms with a 366-day expansion cap, and Codex sessions get CC-Switch router attribution.

### Highlights
- `YYYYMM` and `YYYY` date arguments select a calendar month or year (the year form is a single arg only); every date form still expands to at most 366 days.
- Codex configured with `router = "cc_switch"` now receives message-level attribution: the actual provider and model are backfilled from CC-Switch proxy logs.

### New
- Month and year date forms. Date arguments (`query` and `collect`) now accept `YYYYMM` for a calendar month and `YYYY` for a calendar year (the year form is accepted only as a single arg), alongside day (`YYYYMMDD`) and day/month ranges. A single arg or a range normalizes to an inclusive per-day list capped at 366 days (one leap year); split longer ranges into multiple runs. Invalid forms (`YYYY-MM-DD`, extra positional arguments, a year as a range endpoint, an end date before the start date) fail with an error and command examples. `errors` accepts only a single `YYYYMMDD`.
- CC-Switch router attribution for Codex. Claude-family logs match by `message_id`; Codex proxy logs (`data_source='proxy'`) match by session ID — CC-Switch prefixes Codex session IDs with `codex_`, and stripping it yields the rollout filename UUID — with a nearest-neighbor 300s time window between the proxy row's `created_at` (seconds) and the message timestamp (milliseconds), normalized to milliseconds before comparison; `codex_session` sync rows carry no routing value and are excluded. `config set` and the TUI now accept a router on `codex`. On first open after upgrading, the usage database migrates to schema v3 in a single transaction (adds `data_source` and backfills existing rows from the request-id prefix); CC-Switch databases without the column keep working via strict-prefix local classification. Later rounds recompute the touched sessions in full and overwrite with non-empty values, but backfill never clears an existing attribution. Existing messages can be backfilled with `token-usage collect router --client codex`. Codex attribution was verified with synthetic fixtures only — no live third-party Codex routing was exercised locally; the 300s window is an engineering estimate and the first tuning point if mismatch reports arrive.

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users update in place with `token-usage update`.

<!-- zh -->
v0.1.6 是一个功能版本：日期参数新增月与年形态（展开上限 366 天），Codex 会话接入 CC-Switch 路由归因。

### 亮点
- `YYYYMM` 与 `YYYY` 日期参数分别选择自然月与自然年（年形态仅单独使用）；所有日期形态的展开上限仍为 366 天。
- 配置 `router = "cc_switch"` 的 Codex 现在会做消息级归因：从 CC-Switch 代理日志回填真实供应商与模型。

### 新增
- 月与年日期形态。`query` 与 `collect` 的日期参数现支持 `YYYYMM`（自然月）与 `YYYY`（自然年，仅单独使用），与日（`YYYYMMDD`）、日/月区间并列。单参数或区间统一归一化为逐日列表（含两端），上限 366 天（一个闰年），更长范围请拆分多次执行。非法形态（`YYYY-MM-DD`、多余位置参数、年做区间端点、结束早于开始）报错并给出命令示例。`errors` 只接受单个 `YYYYMMDD`。
- Codex 的 CC-Switch 路由归因。Claude 系日志按 `message_id` 匹配；Codex proxy 日志（`data_source='proxy'`）按 session ID 匹配——CC Switch 给 Codex session ID 加 `codex_` 前缀，剥掉即 rollout 文件名 UUID——proxy 行 `created_at`（秒）与消息时间戳（毫秒）先统一归一为毫秒再做最近邻 300s 时间窗匹配；`codex_session` 同步行无路由价值、被排除。`config set` 与 TUI 现接受为 `codex` 配置 router。升级后首次打开 usage 数据库时，schema 以单事务迁移到 v3（新增 `data_source` 列并按 request_id 前缀回填存量行）；CC-Switch 旧库无该列时经严格前缀本地分类继续工作。后续轮次对触达的 session 全量重算、经非空新值覆盖纠偏，但回填从不清除既有归因。存量消息可用 `token-usage collect router --client codex` 回填。Codex 归因仅经合成 fixture 验证——本机未接入真实第三方 Codex 路由；300s 窗口是工程估值，收到错配/漏配反馈时为第一调参点。

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户用 `token-usage update` 原地升级。
